question: Do the actual best-validation E104/E105 checkpoints, including matching peptide sidecars, pass their own integrity, saved-response reproduction, numerical resolution and parent-relative RMD rhythm checks?
method: Read-only forward audit of all8 selected models. Do not fit, reselection-rank or overwrite any source experiment. Compare selected to selected, never substitute final-checkpoint statistics.
pinning: Resolve each selected SHA and E105 selected peptide SHA from its existing summary; verify before copying and replay. Use copied parent and anchor files verified against their historical recorded hashes. Require one matching original command record. Record all consumed/current data hashes. Historical data and responses hashes missing from originals stay explicitly unavailable.
parent_checkpoint_sha256: Per-case best_val_sha256 and best_val_peptides_sha256, verified at runtime; exact hashes not all printed in supplied earlier stdout and not invented here.

budget.enforcement: Private outer process-group watchdog; incomplete cases remain visible, timeout never qualifies. May finish well before ceiling.

environment: Dedicated server conda /home/carsonc/miniconda3/envs/r-elegans/bin/python, float64. CPU coordinator rebuilds data once per seed/split; GPU workers one per A100, sequential cases on each GPU, 0.8 memory fraction and no preallocation. Existing JAX/NumPy/SciPy/h5py only; no dependency installation. Original/current source/env/argv captured separately.
fixed_trainable: Every selected network, fixed field and peptide value is fixed throughout primary replay. No optimizer created and no parameter updates. Peptide-off diagnostic uses the original E105 raw=-50 ablation only in memory; selected sidecar unchanged. Rhythm references use corresponding stored parent network without a peptide term.
data: Rebuild the identical WT atlas pair statistics with each original seed and every-nth validation split. Record current NWB SHA256 before/after building statistics, reuse derived cache across matching cases. Verify source split counts and targets; replay fit/validation/test metrics without permutation tests. Preserve the known E104-from-E102 validation-contamination flag. No test-based checkpoint selection.
integrity: Verify source completed status, selected/parent/anchor/peptide SHA, copied artifacts and original source archive files, current forward/data/constraint source match, finite source loss log and step count, logged validation-max selection. Derive actual per-run trainable masks and compare saved masks where present. Inspect selected model frozen arrays and declared channel/edge/extra-field bounds, using actual parent for network-frozen E105. Hash optimizer files without deserialization; no exact RNG/state resume claimed.
atlas_replay: Match original dt0.1s,60s settle,120frames,0.5s stimulus at recorded nS/reversal0mV,1.5..11.5s indicator-difference window. Replay all original targets at recorded substeps40, including selected peptide term. Compare fresh replay with stored best_val response. Fine check first13 recorded targets at80substeps with fresh same-protocol settle; no cherry-picking. E105 repeats coarse/fine with original peptide-off diagnostic and checks saved off responses/metrics.
numerical_criteria: Fresh selected-to-saved reproduction: relative tolerance1e-6 plus absolute1e-12, correlation>=0.999999 (exact constants count reproducible, not informative). Coarse-vs-fine: correlation>=0.9 and max absolute difference/max absolute coarse response<0.1; full finite/shape checks. Replayed non-permutation metrics match source best-validation snapshot within rtol1e-7/atol1e-9. Zero-response equality is numerical consistency, not atlas performance.
rhythm: Separate from source-protocol atlas replay:40s no-stimulus recording every2ms with neural max steps1ms versus0.5ms. Warm up parent without peptide60s; selected models60s, or max(60s,5selected peptide tau) rounded up to0.1s. Hold E105 peptide conductance fixed over each original100ms outer interval and update levels only at its boundary, including warmup; refining neural steps must not change peptide cadence. Retain RMD traces and full-network finite/range/late-std diagnostics.
rhythm_criteria: Report persistence on both grids for RMDL/RMDR plus all other RMD cells. Component: bounded sustained amplitude>=2mV, retention0.8..1.2,>=5late peaks; selected period within10% and mean window amplitude within25% of its corresponding parent. Parent must itself pass persistence. Strict cycle convergence (existing compare_cycles) reported separately; no inherited claim of body movement. Capture peptide-related slow settling as protocol, not new fitted dynamics.
original_performance_criteria: E104 selected models: test Spearman>0.127,AUC>=0.574,and for all-parameter variants>network_control by0.02. E105: test Spearman>0.126,AUC>=0.574,and same-checkpoint peptide-on exceeds off by>=0.02. Report these arithmetic gates and whether numerics/integrity allow interpretation; do not reselect by test score. Contaminated validation selection remains flagged.
limits: No body/gait/sensory initiation/stop/rest/restart/swimming/biological qualification. Original 60s atlas settle and independent post-warmup rhythm assay are distinct protocols. Historical raw input hashes/exact resume not manufactured. Peptide term remains stimulation-model-only; no unc-31 comparison or range/diffusion inference. Reproduction checks cover all coarse targets, numerical refinement only first13.
artifacts: Separate external selected-atlas-audit-* folder: source copies of selected models/peptide pairs, parent/anchor, summaries/arguments/source metadata; current data-statistics/evidence cache, per-case responses and RMD traces, parameter/peptide summaries, checks, source hashes and budget receipt. Raw NWBs not copied. All old experiment folders and recursive dependencies retained.

verification.tests: 29 focused software tests passed: exact selected-model and selected-peptide pairing despite invalid final files, independent responses versus actual trusted trainer definitions, original peptide update clock, bounds/frozen/selection/performance gates, input tampering, all8case scheduling with negative/failed-reference outcomes, and timeout non-promotion; related extrasynaptic/all-parameter/atlas tests included.
verification.static: Python compilation, CLI help, shell syntax and whitespace checks passed.
verification.scientific_execution: No E106 server audit or original checkpoint result claimed. Local forwards are tiny software fixtures, not biological/behavior results.
